association: Attach to the shadow forecast whose bundle_sha256 equals parentBundleSha256. The supplement never replaces the persisted path; it adds a geometry layer beside it.
limitations: Exit velocity, launch angle, spray angle in degrees and landing distance in feet are not registered and are emitted as null.
The emitted point is a Retrosheet location-zone centroid, not a measured landing coordinate.
Runner identity is anonymous. A reconstructed movement is a state-consistent template, never a named player's real route.
startFraction and endFraction are presentation sequencing values, not measured timestamps.
V1 does not claim the sampled geometry caused the already-sampled V18 outcome.

rendering.ballTrace: Draw only when contactOccurred is true and ballTrace is present. Use start, control and end in the normalized coordinate system, mapping y to the home-plate-to-centre-field axis.
rendering.failClosed: If geometry is missing, absent or fails verification, render the existing Broadcast Replay without ball traces. Never synthesise a trajectory in the consumer.
modelledVersusPersisted: Fields under geometry and runnerMovements are MODELLED. outcome, outs, base masks, runs and scores are PERSISTED V18 state and must be rendered exactly as given.
rendering.preserveExisting: The existing V18 Broadcast Replay remains the default view. Play Geometry is an additional, separately labelled view.
rendering.runnerTrace: Draw one path per runnerMovements entry using from/to base states. startFraction/endFraction are presentation sequencing values only.
rendering.timing: No measured timing authority exists. Never present startFraction/endFraction as elapsed real time.

verification: Hash play-geometry-supplement.json canonically and require it to equal supplementSha256.
Require parentBundleSha256 to equal the registered V18 shadow forecast's bundle checksum before associating the supplement.
